validation_boundary: The authoritative ATOM Pydantic model, sufficiency validator, JSON Schema, and exact SEA v4 protocol were not directly retrievable in this session. Validation therefore uses a strict local Pydantic contract and generated JSON Schema reconstructed from recent validated project guideline artifacts, plus the retrieved large-source guideline guardrail. This report does not claim execution of unavailable authoritative project code.

duplicate_review.finding: All atom_id values are unique, one publication_id is shared across the packet, and each of the 62 formal guidance identifiers was extracted once.

consistency_review.finding: Formal guidance grades were preserved in tags. The Figure 1 versus Supplementary Table S6 sofosbuvir/velpatasvir sample-size discrepancy was retained as a source-integrity issue rather than reconciled.

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom pattern used in recent project guideline outputs has no dedicated guideline_recommendation atom kind. Formal guidance is serialized as atom_kind="other" with descriptive tags.
Recommendation strength and GRADE certainty are preserved in tags rather than dedicated typed fields.
Trial results in this guideline are secondary reports. Primary-study atoms require separate extraction of the cited primary publications.
extraction_limitations: Canonical statements normalize PDF ligatures, line-wrap hyphenation, and inequality symbols without adding unreported clinical details.
The supplementary evidence tables support SEA evidence reconciliation; individual primary-study rows were not converted into primary-study atoms.
All atoms remain needs_review because no human source verification step is represented.
No external current-guideline or regulatory verification was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
